name: Keshav Singh
title: Senior Software Engineer • .NET / Cloud / Microservices / Angular
summary: Results-driven engineer delivering distributed, secure & observable platforms across Azure and AWS. Designed microservice & event-driven (gRPC, Lambda, Step Functions, queues) architectures, implemented identity (Azure AD B2C custom policies), performance tuning (40% latency improvements) & IaC (ARM, API Gateway, Kubernetes). Passionate about accessible UI, resilient services & reusable internal packages.

Integrated push notifications via Azure SignalR (real-time messaging).
